description: Four-piece ceramic brake pad set shown with its Duralast Elite box, which advertises 3X longer life. The friction surface has a honeycomb-textured ceramic compound over a steel backing plate, with hardware included where required.
Four-piece brake pad set pictured with its Duralast Gold box. The pads have a smooth dark friction surface on steel backing plates, with chamfered leading edges and a central wear slot.

Four-piece semi-metallic brake pad set shown with its Duralast Gold box, which lists an OE-grade semi-metallic formulation, OE slots and chamfers for quiet stopping, and low dust output. Pads include attached shims.
Set of four brake pads with a curved front-pad profile, plain grey friction material and a single centre slot across each pad. Shown loose without packaging, so no brand markings are visible.
Brake pad set shown in its red and blue Duralast box, marked as the official brakes of NASCAR and containing one complete set. The pads pictured on the box have a slotted friction surface.
Set of four brake pads in a curved front-pad shape, supplied as two grey uncoated pads and two black-coated pads with mounting ears. Shown loose without packaging.
Black spin-on oil filter canister with a white Bosch label marked Premium Oil Filter and the part number 3978. Standard sealed steel can with a rolled base seam and threaded mounting plate.

Cartridge-style oil filter element with tan pleated media, a black plastic end cap with lift tabs, and a separate sealing ring, shown beside its STP box marked with a 5,000 mile change interval. No metal canister - the element drops into a housing.
Blue spin-on oil filter canister shown with its matching STP box, marked with a 5,000 mile change interval and the part number S45023. Sealed steel can with a threaded base plate and rubber gasket.
Rectangular panel air filter with a moulded black rubber frame and yellow pleated paper media. The frame is printed with FLOW direction arrows and a TOP orientation marking.

Cone-shaped performance air filter with red oiled cotton-gauze media, a polished chrome end cap, a black rubber mounting flange and a stainless hose clamp. Clamp-on type for cold-air or short-ram intakes.
Circular air filter with a black rubber sealing frame and gold-tan paper media pleated radially around a central mounting hole.
Oval performance air filter with red cotton-gauze media pleated radially around a centre hub, set in a black rubber frame printed 'Premium Performance Filter'.

Flat rectangular cabin air filter with a plastic frame and pleated media that alternates white filtration layers with grey activated-carbon layers for odour absorption. Note this is a cabin filter rather than an engine intake filter.

OEM port fuel injector featuring a long, slim stainless-steel body, black electrical connector, precision fuel nozzle, and dual sealing O-rings. Designed to deliver accurate low-pressure fuel atomization for multi-port fuel injection systems, ensuring smooth engine performance, improved fuel economy, and reliable cold starts.

High-pressure gasoline direct injection fuel injector with a compact reinforced stainless-steel body, precision multi-hole nozzle, high-pressure fuel inlet, and integrated electrical connector. Engineered for direct combustion chamber injection, delivering superior atomization, enhanced combustion efficiency, reduced emissions, and improved engine responsiveness.

Heavy-duty common rail diesel fuel injector featuring an elongated steel body, high-pressure fuel connector, precision injector nozzle, and electronic solenoid control. Designed for modern common rail diesel engines requiring precise fuel metering, high-pressure operation, excellent durability, and reduced exhaust emissions.

compatible_vehicles: Volkswagen Jetta 1.9 TDI PD (2005–2010)|Skoda Octavia 1.9 TDI PD (2006–2010)
description: Integrated diesel unit injector combining a high-pressure fuel pump and injector into a single assembly. Features a large mounting flange, complex machined housing, heavy-duty steel construction, and electronic control connector for precise high-pressure fuel delivery, exceptional combustion efficiency, and long service life.

Dual-fuel injector rail assembly consisting of four precision LPG/CNG injectors mounted on a common aluminum rail with integrated mounting brackets and gas inlet fittings. Designed for sequential gaseous fuel injection systems, providing accurate fuel distribution, stable engine operation, improved fuel economy, and reliable long-term performance.

Electronic drive-by-wire throttle body featuring a precision-machined cast aluminum housing, integrated black electronic actuator motor, throttle position sensor, and sealed butterfly valve. Designed for precise airflow control, improved fuel efficiency, and seamless ECU communication.

Mechanical throttle body equipped with a throttle cable pulley, return spring mechanism, and cast aluminum housing. Provides direct mechanical throttle response, reliable airflow regulation, and durable operation for cable-operated accelerator systems.

High-performance CNC-machined billet aluminum throttle body featuring dual butterfly valves for increased airflow. Designed for racing and performance applications requiring improved throttle response, higher intake volume, and enhanced engine breathing.

product_name: Throttle Body with Idle Air Control Valve
description: OEM-style throttle body incorporating an integrated Idle Air Control valve, throttle position sensor, and multiple vacuum ports. Provides stable idle speed, accurate airflow management, and reliable engine performance under varying operating conditions.

product_name: Diesel Air Intake Throttle Valve Assembly
description: Heavy-duty diesel air intake throttle valve assembly featuring a reinforced cast aluminum housing, oversized electronic actuator, wide intake passages, and industrial-grade construction. Optimized for diesel engines to improve EGR operation, airflow regulation, emissions control, and long-term durability.

product_name: Hydraulic Power Steering Pump with Reservoir
description: OEM hydraulic power steering pump featuring an integrated black plastic fluid reservoir, precision-machined cast aluminum housing, belt-driven pulley, and high-pressure hydraulic ports. Designed to deliver smooth steering assistance, reliable hydraulic pressure, and long service life with low-noise operation.

product_name: Hydraulic Power Steering Pump without Reservoir
description: Compact hydraulic power steering pump with a cast aluminum body, exposed belt-driven pulley, precision hydraulic inlet and outlet ports, and durable OEM construction. Designed for vehicles using a remotely mounted fluid reservoir, providing efficient steering assistance and dependable hydraulic performance.

Electro-hydraulic power steering pump combining a high-efficiency hydraulic pump with an integrated electric motor and electronic control module. Features multiple electrical connectors, compact integrated construction, and intelligent on-demand hydraulic pressure for improved fuel efficiency and precise steering response.

product_name: Wheel Hub Assembly with ABS Sensor
description: Premium front wheel hub assembly with integrated ABS wheel speed sensor and pre-installed sealed bearing. Features a precision-machined 5-lug flange, corrosion-resistant steel construction, and factory-installed electrical connector for accurate ABS performance. Designed for smooth wheel rotation, reduced vibration, and long service life.

product_name: Wheel Hub Assembly without ABS Sensor
description: High-quality wheel hub assembly without an ABS sensor, featuring an integrated sealed bearing and durable 5-lug steel flange. Engineered for reliable wheel support and low rolling resistance. Suitable for vehicles that do not require ABS sensor integration.

Compact 4-lug wheel hub assembly designed for lightweight passenger vehicles. Manufactured from precision-machined steel with an integrated double-row bearing for smooth operation and enhanced durability. Ideal replacement for worn or noisy wheel hub assemblies.

Heavy-duty 6-lug wheel hub assembly engineered for pickup trucks and commercial vehicles. Features a reinforced cast-steel housing, oversized sealed bearing, and high-load wheel studs for exceptional durability under demanding road and towing conditions. Built for long-lasting performance in harsh environments.
Bare cast iron exhaust manifold with a rough dark grey as-cast finish, four siamesed runners feeding a single central outlet, and machined flange faces with six mounting holes.
Short tubular header with polished stainless runners welded to a thick black four-port flange plate. The runners curve tightly into a compact collector with a bolted outlet flange.

product_name: Exhaust Manifold with Integrated Catalytic Converter
description: Brushed stainless manifold with three tubular runners merging into a barrel-shaped catalytic converter. Includes a bolted inlet flange, welded mounting brackets and an outlet flange.
Polished stainless long-tube header with four equal-length runners of large diameter sweeping into a single open collector pipe. Weld seams show heat colouring at each joint.

Manifold and catalytic converter assembly with a dull weathered steel finish. The converter body carries stamped identification text, and there is a threaded oxygen sensor bung ahead of the outlet flange.

Manifold with integrated catalytic converter viewed from the flange side, showing four dark exhaust ports in a cast flange. Stainless runners merge upward into the converter, with a side outlet pipe and welded brackets.

Turbocharger mounted directly to a four-port cast exhaust manifold. The assembly includes the turbine housing, compressor housing with machined outlet, and an electronic wastegate actuator with its wiring connector.

Compact stainless manifold with three runners merging into a cylindrical catalytic converter. A flat triangular mounting flange sits at the inlet and a threaded oxygen sensor bung ahead of the outlet.
Pair of complete strut assemblies, each with a black coil spring, yellow spring seat, silver upper mounting plate with hub, and a black damper body with a welded lower bracket.
Pair of coilover shocks with red powder-coated coil springs over polished chrome damper bodies, a yellow threaded spring-height adjuster ring, and eyelet mounts with pressed bushings at both ends.
Single coilover shock with a black coil spring over a polished chrome body, an angled upper eyelet and a straight lower eyelet, both fitted with bronze-bushed mounting eyes.
Front strut assembly with a dark coil spring over a cast aluminium strut housing. The lower housing forms an integral steering knuckle bracket with multiple bolt holes and a fork for the brake line.

Performance coilover with a silver coil spring, threaded body adjuster collars, and a piggyback remote reservoir clamped alongside for extra oil capacity. Machined aluminium lower mount with an eyelet.
Bare front strut without a spring - a black damper body with an upper spring seat, protruding piston rod, welded lower mounting bracket and a brake hose clip.
Air suspension strut with a double-convoluted black rubber air bellows over a polished body, an air line fitting at the top and a forged U-shaped lower mounting bracket.
Pair of plain twin-tube shock absorbers with matte black bodies, dust sleeves and eyelet mounts at both ends fitted with bronze-coloured bushings. Supplied without springs.
Cylindrical control arm bushing viewed end-on, with black rubber bonded between a steel outer shell and a steel inner sleeve. Moulded voids on opposite sides tune the bushing's compliance.
Suspension bushing viewed end-on with grey rubber bonded inside a polished steel outer ring. The inner steel sleeve has a finely splined face for a locked press fit.
Polyurethane bushing viewed end-on, showing translucent amber and orange urethane rings between a steel outer shell and a steel inner sleeve.
Matched left and right control arm bushings, each pressed into a cast metal mounting bracket with an elongated bolt slot. The black rubber centres have moulded relief voids around a hex inner sleeve.
Set of three green polyurethane bushings, each a short barrel of solid urethane around a steel inner sleeve, with a slightly waisted outer profile.
Single moulded rubber suspension bushing with an hourglass body and flared ends, showing a metal inner sleeve at the centre bore. Supplied as a press-in rubber component with no outer shell.
Bushing pressed into a flat black mounting bracket with a bolt hole at each end. The barrel-shaped rubber body sits between the two arms of the bracket.
Kit of three white polyurethane bushings in graduated sizes, each with a top-hat profile - a flanged base with a raised body and a central bore.
